system.concept: Hunted Tremere hiding among New Orleans' outcasts after two disastrous unauthorized Embraces
system.biography:
Background

Still counted a child by his clan despite centuries of unlife, Antonio has spent his career fleeing the consequences of Embracing two childer without the Council of Seven's permission: the alchemist Nigel Porter, whom he rescued from execution in Vienna, and Marie D'Richet, a young mage's daughter who used him only to join her lover Prince Marcel in undeath. Still hunted by his own clan, Antonio hides among New Orleans' outcast Kindred, aware of but estranged from his childe Nigel, whom he believes is better off without him.

Roleplaying Hints

Hyperactive and restless, with too many of your own problems to spare much concern for anyone else's, unless a favor is on offer.

Disciplines (as printed, dot-rating, converted to owned Discipline Items on this Actor at Storyteller discretion): Animalism 2, Auspex 5, Celerity 1, Dominate 4, Fortitude 1, Obfuscate 2, Presence 1, Thaumaturgy 5 (Weather Control 4, Path of Conjuring 4, Movement of the Mind 3, Lure of Flames 2, Spirit Thaumaturgy 2). Antonio has developed several rituals of his own, including one that detects whether a person has ever wielded magical energies and one that raises an impenetrable black fog.
system.notes: Sire: Astio Giavetti. Secretly Blood Bound to the Council of Seven. Haven: abandoned buildings outside the city limits. Secrets rating: C+.

items.name: Thaumaturgy — 2 Intermediate — Command the Freshly Dead

system.description:
The vampire can command any ghost she can see to obey her, receiving answers to questions within the ghost's realm of awareness or sending it to deliver a message. She cannot compel a ghost to perform any task requiring a material form.

System: The vampire must first use See the Dead to locate a desired ghost, then wins a contested Willpower roll against the wraith (most ghosts have 5 Willpower). Each success scored over the wraith's own answers one question or performs one simple action.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers

items.name: Thaumaturgy — 2 Intermediate — Heart of the Wood

system.description:
The vampire may take refuge within the living wood of any tree standing inside her realm of attunement, concealing her presence from enemies; her aura blends with the tree's, increasing the difficulty of detecting her by two Traits' worth of supernatural senses. While inside, she may use Disciplines and abilities not dependent on physical gestures or eye contact. Sheltering within a tree also protects her from the rising sun. If the tree is chopped down she suffers five levels of damage and is forced out; burning the tree inflicts the same damage as aggravated.

System: The vampire drinks a mixture of blood and tree sap, then rolls Willpower. A single success allows her to remain inside a tree for one turn; two successes extend this to a scene; three or more successes let her remain for up to 24 hours, after which the tree ejects her.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Thaumaturgy: Path of the World's Blood; must be attuned to the land

system.description: You may double the range of your sight and hearing and sharpen your other senses to remarkable acuity, perceiving things ordinary folk cannot. A sudden sensory assault, such as a loud noise or strong odor, numbs the affected sense for the rest of the scene and stuns you for a turn unless you spend a Willpower Trait. You may also receive uncontrollable visions of past or future events.
By meeting your subject's gaze and winning a Mental Challenge, you implant a more complex command, optionally tied to a specific trigger event, to be carried out immediately or later.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
